limits: Profiling overhead is not isolated; SQL times are diagnostic.
The longest reclaim event and exact-thread CPU samples establish lock contention within reclaim, not the complete lock wait duration or identity of its owner.
Thread monitor rows are not atomic snapshots; each row has sampler_seconds and individual reads can occur late in the sampling cycle.
Timer CPU samples and kernel hardware-cycle samples are different observation scopes.
No kernel policy or engine optimization was tested in this follow-up.
Memory counters have monitoring gaps; Cached and MemAvailable are not immediately free Normal-zone pages.
